drhp.business: Devson Catalyst Limited is an indigenous manufacturer of catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls that are used to improve process efficiency and facilitate removal of impurities from gases and liquids across various industrial applications. Its products are supplied to customers operating in industries such as oil and gas refineries, petrochemicals, steel, fertilizers and other industrial processing sectors, in both domestic and international markets. The Company operates a single manufacturing facility in Gujarat with a total installed capacity of approximately 6,205.00 MT per annum.
drhp.end_markets: Oil and gas refineries|Petrochemicals|Steel|Fertilizers|Other industrial processing sectors
drhp.expansion: The Company proposes to utilise net proceeds of the Offer towards funding the capital expenditure requirements for setting up a new manufacturing unit, in addition to funding working capital requirements and general corporate purposes.
drhp.one_liner: Devson Catalyst Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified indigenous manufacturer of catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls used as key materials in various industrial processes.

financial_valuation.risk: Any of the following risks, as well as the other risks and uncertainties discussed in this Red Herring Prospectus, could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects and could cause the trading price of our Equity Shares to decline, which could result in the loss of all or a part of Investor’s investment.

We expect to remain reliant on our key customers for the foreseeable future and the loss of any key customer for any of the reasons described above could adversely affect our business, results of operations, cash flows, and financial condition. 2.

As a result, this risk could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows, and may also adversely affect the trading price of our Equity Shares. 3.

internal_operational.risk: Our revenues are concentrated among a limited number of customers, and the loss of one or more such customers, deterioration in their financial condition, or a reduction in their demand for our products could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

A substantial portion of our revenue from operations is derived from few customers, including large customers in the oil & gas, refining, petrochemical, steel and fertilizer value chains that procure catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls for critical process units.
The absence of long-term contracts with our customers exposes us to a significant risk of customer attrition and challenges in relation to production planning.

strategy_growth.risk: Further, given our export presence, demand and collections may also be impacted by developments in overseas markets, including changes in industrial activity, regulatory or trade conditions, currency volatility and international logistics disruptions, which may add to variability in our revenues and cash flows.

Our export business, is dependent on overseas distributors, and any disruption in our engagement with such distributors could adversely affect our revenues and results of operations For our export-related activities, we rely on third-party distributors located outside India to identify potential customers, generate business leads and procure orders on our behalf in overseas markets.
There can be no assurance that our overseas distributors will continue to represent us effectively, maintain customer relationships, or generate a consistent volume of orders in the future.

concerns_observed: Customer concentration: top 1 customer 22.82% and top 5 customers 66.80% of revenue in H1 FY26, with no long-term customer contracts.

Single-facility, leasehold-land concentration: all manufacturing is at one site in Surendranagar, Gujarat, on leasehold plots (leases expiring 2073-2082); the proposed new unit is also on leasehold land.

Execution risk on the primary use of proceeds: the company has obtained quotations but has not placed firm orders for 100% of the plant and machinery for the new manufacturing unit funded from Net Proceeds (total project cost Rs 1,934.42 lakhs; fresh-issue funding Rs 1,739.84 lakhs).

red_flags: 40:1 bonus issue on December 24, 2025, within 18 months of the Offer, capitalising reserves shortly before listing.
Promoter average cost of acquisition materially below the Offer Price (Rs 0.24 / Rs 0.14 per share; Nil for two Promoters).
45 delayed ROC statutory-form filings and a GNL-2 voluntary disclosure to the ROC (filed February 19, 2026), plus Board-meeting reporting discrepancies over FY2014-15 to FY2021-22.

strengths_observed: Consistent top-line growth with margin expansion: revenue from operations rose from Rs 3,253.15 lakhs (FY23) to Rs 4,346.99 lakhs (FY24) to Rs 5,319.21 lakhs (FY25), while EBITDA margin expanded from 11.01% (FY23) to 15.29% (FY24) to 20.42% (FY25).
Strong and improving profitability: PAT grew from Rs 233.55 lakhs (FY23) to Rs 407.84 lakhs (FY24) to Rs 767.23 lakhs (FY25); H1 (period ended Sep 30, 2025) PAT was Rs 663.35 lakhs.
High capital efficiency: ROE 44.76% and ROCE 44.71% in FY25 (ROE 36.20% FY24, 29.26% FY23), with RoNW 36.57% in FY25.

Conservative balance sheet: total debt of Rs 119.92 lakhs against net worth of Rs 2,761.08 lakhs as at Sep 30, 2025 (net-cash position with Rs 238.45 lakhs cash), and positive operating cash flow in every reported period (CFO Rs 505.86 lakhs in H1 FY26).

Niche indigenous manufacturer of catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls positioned as an import-substitution play in a segment the DRHP describes as having significant entry barriers; recognised among Top 10 Adsorbents & Desiccants manufacturers (Industry Outlook).

Diversified end-markets (oil & gas refining, petrochemicals, steel, fertilizers) and export footprint across 15+ countries; ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified single facility with ~6,205 MT/annum capacity.
No Promoter shares pledged as on the date of the DRHP.

summary.business: Devson Catalyst Limited is an indigenous manufacturer of catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls that are used to improve process efficiency and facilitate removal of impurities from gases and liquids across various industrial applications. Its products are supplied to customers operating in industries such as oil and gas refineries, petrochemicals, steel, fertilizers and other industrial processing sectors, in both domestic and international markets. The Company operates a single manufacturing facility in Gujarat with a total installed capacity of approximately 6,205.00 MT per annum.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Claims against the company not acknowledged as debts of Rs. 32.46 Lakhs (GST demand, appeal filed May 13, 2024, pending at SGST Appellate Authority) pertaining to ITC availment for FY 2017-18
- Company has taken loans from Promoters and Promoter-group HUFs (e.g. borrowing balances of Rs. 81.10 Lakhs and Rs. 29.20 Lakhs as at 31-Mar-25) creating dependence on related-party funding
- All manufacturing operations are carried out at one facility in Wadhwan City, Surendranagar, Gujarat, concentrating operational risk at a single location

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:

- **Company will list its Equity Shares on the SME Platform of BSE (BSE SME) to enhance its corporate image, brand visibility, provide liquidity to existing shareholders and create a public trading market.**
